'''Marvon''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] xenospecialist who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] within the Imperial fleet. While on board, Marvon wore a [[Color/Legends|bronze]] and blue suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and sold various equipment from a desk.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Marvon first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]]. In the game he served as an Imperial ultimate gear vendor, accepting only commendations as payment. Marvon's armor conceals what species he is in the game. He was later removed as a vendor and NPC in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system. Nonetheless, he remains in the game, as his character model is used as part of the background environment in the redesigned fleet areas.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
